notes.title: [Summer Event] Grab Ripuka's Limited-Time Skin
notes.content: [p]🍉Summer Event Is On!🍉[/p][p]It's summer, the season for watermelon smashing![/p][p]A new event quest is here where you can get the exclusive Watermelon Skin for Ripuka![/p][p]Plus, test your skills in a new, limited-time ultra-hard dungeon![/p][p][/p][p](Event quests can be attempted regardless of your main story progress.)[/p]

notes.title: ver1.1.2 [Bug Fixes] Fixed an issue when launching the game
notes.content: Since ver1.1.1, we've fixed a bug that prevented players from advancing beyond the title screen on their initial game launch.

notes.content:

notes.title: [Spring Event] Here's your chance to get Isha's limited-time skin!
notes.content:
🌸 Spring Event is Here! 🌸
Spring has blossomed in Isha's village!
Take on a special event quest featuring cherry blossom-themed enemies!
Clear this quest to earn Isha's limited-edition cherry blossom skin!

Duration: April 25, 2025 - June 27, 2025 (In Japan Time)

(Event quest are available to all players, regardless of their progress in the main story.)
